scope: Bounded M-21 extraction of the product and service catalog HTTP handlers from the API server composition module, with M-23 hotspot remeasurement.

repository_identity.note: Evidence applies to this dirty working tree based on the recorded HEAD, not a candidate or release.

boundary_decision.current: Product/service route parsing, authorization calls, account checks, service operations, audit calls, and HTTP responses were embedded in server.ts alongside runtime composition and other routes.
boundary_decision.proposed: Keep route behavior in a dedicated HTTP module while server.ts owns composition and injects product/service service interfaces, principal authorization, and audit callbacks.
boundary_decision.authorization_and_tenant_invariant: List/create operations use the authenticated principal account; item GET/PATCH compare the loaded product or service account before responding or updating; existing permission codes and audit data remain unchanged.
boundary_decision.compatibility_target: Preserve route dispatch order, request parsing and validation, status/body behavior, permission checks, account ownership checks, audit calls, and service method arguments.
boundary_decision.persistence_boundary: The route module receives ProductsService and ServicesService interfaces and does not import repositories or database clients.

extraction.dispatch_seam: Immediately after handleUsersStaffQuotesRoutes and before the /breeds dispatch; the same product/service instances, requirePrincipal function, and appendAudit callback are passed.
